subject: South Korea VAT registration & PO billing-entity mapping for Hanbit Labs
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Jin Park <jin.park@hanbitlabs.kr>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: South Korea VAT registration & PO billing-entity mapping for Hanbit Labs

Hi Jin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Hanbit onboarded as a supplier for the localization module work (PO-98432). Before we issue the PO and enable invoice routing, procurement needs a couple of tax/VAT confirmations so we set up the vendor correctly in our system and avoid invoice rejections. Can you please confirm the following by EOD your local time tomorrow (Tue, Jun 30)?

1) Official Korean business registration number (사업자등록번호) as shown on your BR certificate — we'll need a scanned copy (PDF).
2) Are you registered for Korean VAT (부가가치세)? If yes, please provide the VAT registration number and a recent tax invoice sample showing VAT charged. If not, confirm whether you are VAT-exempt and provide supporting documentation.
3) Which legal entity should we list on the PO and on invoices for proper VAT handling? (e.g., Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd — local KR entity). If you have a local branch or alternative invoicing entity, please indicate which one issues VAT invoices.
4) Bank details for USD wire and beneficiary name as they appear on your bank statement (we'll include in the PO to prevent payment delays).

I've attached our PO billing-entity matrix template (redwood_po-98432-billing-matrix.xlsx) — please fill the highlighted rows and return along with the BR scan. If you prefer, we can route PO and payment to Redwood Inference Pte Ltd (SG) instead of Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — note that routing to our Singapore entity may impact VAT reclaimability on your side, so let us know which you prefer.

Appreciate a quick turnaround so we can get the PO live this week.

Best,

Michael Grant
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_po-98432-billing-matrix.xlsx
From: Jin Park <jin.park@hanbitlabs.kr>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Seong-Woo Kim <swkim@hanbitlabs.kr>, finance@hanbitlabs.kr
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: South Korea VAT registration & PO billing-entity mapping for Hanbit Labs

Hi Michael — thanks for reaching out. Happy to confirm details below and I've attached our BR scan.

1) Business registration number (사업자등록번호): 214-81-77645
   - Attached: hanbit_br_certificate.pdf (scanned BR)
2) VAT registration: Yes — Hanbit Labs is VAT-registered. VAT invoice examples available; we charge standard 10% VAT on services. VAT registration number is the same as BR number above for domestic tax reporting.
   - Attached: sample_korean_tax_invoice.pdf (redacted customer info)
3) Invoicing/legal entity: Please issue PO and invoices to:
   Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd.
   3F, Samseong Building, 45 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
   Business reg no: 214-81-77645
   This entity issues VAT invoices. We cannot issue invoices from a non-Korean entity for domestic VAT purposes.
4) Bank details (USD wires):
   Beneficiary: Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd.
   Bank: Kookmin Bank
   SWIFT: CZNBKRSEXXX
   Account: 123-456-789012

Notes: If Redwood requires invoicing to your Singapore entity for corporate reasons, we can issue a commercial invoice (no Korean VAT) but then we cannot issue a Korean tax invoice for VAT reclaim. For standard local VAT flow (10% VAT, reclaimable by Redwood's KR entity if applicable) the PO must name Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd.

Let me know if the BR scan looks fine and whether you want the PO mapped to Hanbit Labs (KR) or routed to Redwood Singapore.

Regards,

Jin Park
Operations Lead
Hanbit Labs

Attachments: hanbit_br_certificate.pdf, sample_korean_tax_invoice.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jin.park@hanbitlabs.kr
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: South Korea VAT registration & PO billing-entity mapping for Hanbit Labs

Hi Jin / Michael,

Thanks for the quick response and the BR scan — that helps. Two procurement points to clarify from Redwood's side:

- Redwood billing options: for APAC suppliers we typically prefer to route POs through Redwood Inference Pte Ltd (Singapore) for consolidated APAC processing. However, given your confirmation that a Korean tax invoice is required for VAT reclaim, we will issue the PO to Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd (KR) so you can charge VAT and Hanbit can remit VAT to Korean authorities. Please confirm you will issue a Korean tax invoice against the PO once the work is complete.

- Tax withholding: Are there any local withholding requirements for foreign companies receiving services from Korean entities? If there are withholding taxes for payments to your account, please flag them and provide rates so finance can model gross-up.

Action items for Jin:
1) Confirm Hanbit will issue a Korean tax invoice (세금계산서) against the PO.
2) Return the completed redwood_po-98432-billing-matrix.xlsx with the billing contact and bank details filled.
3) If Hanbit prefers routing to Redwood Singapore (no Korean VAT on invoice), state that explicitly and we will evaluate.

Michael — once we have the completed matrix and confirmation on tax invoice issuance, procurement will generate the PO and route it for signatures.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Procurement (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: South Korea VAT registration & PO billing-entity mapping for Hanbit Labs

Hi Jin — thanks, the BR PDF looks good and bank details are clear.

We will proceed as follows unless we hear otherwise from you by EOD KST:
- PO will be issued to: Hanbit Labs Co., Ltd (KR) — to allow you to charge Korean VAT (10%).
- PO number: PO-98432. Our finance team will include the PO number on the invoice and remit via USD wire to the account you provided.
- Please complete and return the filled billing matrix (I attached the template again). Once returned, I will issue the formal PO and share the DocuSign envelope for signature.

If you prefer the alternative (route to Redwood Inference Pte Ltd / SG with no Korean VAT), state that clearly; otherwise expect the PO to list the Korean entity.

Mina Haddad
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
